Class TriggeredFoodRewardEffect

java.lang.Object
mesos.effects.BuildingEffect
mesos.effects.TriggeredFoodRewardEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TriggeredFoodRewardEffect extends BuildingEffect
Building effect that grants food whenever the player's tribe reaches a new complete set or a new matching inventor pair (depending on the trigger type).
